Alibaba Cloud RDS MySQL Health Inspection Skill – Initial Release

- Introduces automated batch health checks for Alibaba Cloud RDS MySQL instances, supporting single, multiple, or all-instance scans with a customizable 1–30 day window.
- Generates individual HTML health reports per instance and a summary report, including health scoring and optimization suggestions.
- Inspects instance basics, resource utilization, alert history, DAS table/slow log stats, cluster per-node health, and kernel version/expiration status.
- Automatically detects available regions and relevant RDS instances; region and instance selection is fully automated based on user input.
- Requires only Python standard library; no external Python dependencies or pip installs needed.
- Strictly enforces Aliyun CLI AI-mode, user-agent identification, credential handling, and required RAM permissions for secure, compliant operation.
- Includes clear CLI pre-checks and step-by-step usage examples for fast onboarding.
